leadText:
Go Beyond is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Mega Voltage arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, debuting in HZ090 and replacing Only One Story (Korean ver.). The opening animation uses the same footage as the corresponding Japanese theme, GET BACK.

The song is also used as the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Episode: Mega Evolution arc (which was aired before the Mega Voltage arc in the Korean dub), using the same footage as the Japanese ending YUU.

The full version of the song was released on October 14, 2025. The opening animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 21, 2026.

The full version of the song was released on October 14, 2025. The opening animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 21, 2026.

 
 
 

==Opening animation (HZ090 - HZ111)==
===Synopsis===
Liko, Roy, Dot, , , and step forward and watch the sunrise, with the screen suddenly switching to a film-like montage of the Rising Volt Tacklers before 's Evolution into Meowscarada.

In a grassy field, Liko and Meowscarada look into the distance before walking away. The two are then joined by and Pagogo, sitting on the stairs under the shade, watching Trainers and Pokémon. Roy, Crocalor, , , and Captain Pikachu in a forest are shown for a brief moment, followed by Dot (who was eating a donut), Quaxwell, , and then Ult and on a tree, a , and finally Liko finishing getting ready as Meowscarada stretches from the bed. 

A series of flashback transitions occur as , Floragato, and Meowscarada appear. After tying her shoes, Liko sets off with Meowscarada, Hattrem, and Pagogo in tow. The camera pans over the characters during certain times of the day – starting with Hattrem at dawn, Meowscarada at daytime, Liko in the evening, alongside , and Pagogo at night in its . Liko looks up as green leaves appear when she opens her eyes. Under the green spotlight stands Liko and Meowscarada, whose flowers explode into pink petals.

Liko and Meowscarada are shown battling Coral, Sidian, , and . At the snap of Meowscarada's fingers, several of her flowers fall from above as Meowscarada does the same. The Explorers are shown one by one, starting with Coral, Sidian, Glalie, and Garganacl, followed by Chalce and , and ending with Spinel and , with Indi and Rubina behind them. The sun sets at a beach, Amethio and watching it from ashore. The Rising Volt Tacklers' flag is back blowing in the wind after their reunion. Liko is running towards the left side of the screen, reaching out for something as the series logo appears.

Roy and Cap appear right after the series logo, with the two, Crocalor, Lucario, and Kilowattrel moving along a path as Roy's Mega Ring briefly shines. In a city, Ult stares at his Dusk Ball in an alleyway before briefly glancing at camera while leaving. Cap falls into an abyss as the camera zooms out of his eye, with Cap looking confident on Roy's shoulder once the camera fully zooms out. Roy and his Pokémon team have dinner together around a campfire, unaware of the Black Rayquaza flying above them.

Once again, the camera pans over the characters during certain times of the day – starting with Kilowattrel at daytime, Crocalor in the evening, Roy and Cap at night, and Lucario at dawn. Roy looks up as orange sparks appear when he opens his eyes. Under the red spotlight stands Roy and Crocalor, who shoots towards the camera.

Clinking their Mega Rings, Roy and Ult stand back to back as their Mega Pokémon battle on the ground. In the air, Kilowattrel and Crocalor attack with and Flamethrower. Mega Lucario shows up behind them and attacks the ground. On a Rotom Phone, Roy and Crocalor dance, Ult and Sableye exchange high-fives, Liko and Meowscarada also dance, and finally Dot exchanges high-fives with Quaxwell and Tinkatuff before taking back the phone during a group shot.

The four Trainers and their Pokémon face the camera. From behind, they look towards the sky, being joined by the Rising Volt Tacklers, Ann, , and various other Trainers and Pokémon as the camera zooms out. Liko and Roy lie on the grass, happily playing with their respective partners.

aiReadySummary.title: Go Beyond
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Go Beyond
Category:Korean opening themes
Go Beyond is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Mega Voltage arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, debuting in HZ090 and replacing Only One Story (Korean ver.). The opening animation uses the same footage as the corresponding Japanese theme, GET BACK.

The song is also used as the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Episode: Mega Evolution arc (which was aired before the Mega Voltage arc in the Korean dub), using the same footage as the Japanese ending YUU.

The full version of the song was released on October 14, 2025. The opening animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 21, 2026.
